deck_notes.ISLR2 Ch4_Classification: Core p1-70. LDA/QDA (p29-63) is heavier than your syllabus needs — skim. Evaluation content you actually want is p56-58 (types of errors, varying the threshold, ROC). SKIP p91-101 (GLM/Poisson, out of scope).
deck_notes.ISLR2 Ch5_Resampling: Use nearly all of it. p25-32 ('Cross-validation: right and wrong' / the 'NO!' sequence) is the single best thing in this pack — it teaches the feature-selection-before-CV mistake that students make constantly.
deck_notes.ISLR2 Ch8_Tree_Based_Methods: STOP AT p55 ('Summary'). p56-79 is BART (Bayesian Additive Regression Trees) — graduate-level and out of scope.
deck_notes.ISLR2 Ch12_Unsupervised: Core p1-58 (PCA p1-24, k-means p25-39, hierarchical p40-58). p59-76 is matrix completion / recommender systems — good enrichment, not required.
deck_notes.UDL CM20315_07_Gradients: Core is slides 1-57 (backprop, forward/backward pass, ReLU derivative, autodiff) and 100 (PyTorch). Slides 58-99 are a long expectation/variance refresher building to He initialization — compress hard if students have had the stats prereq.
deck_notes.Harvard EmbeddedEthiCS CS181: WARNING: 3 pages, and it is a module WRITE-UP (lesson plan), not a slide deck. Describes a healthcare racial-bias case (Obermeyer et al., Science 2019) and discussion structure. Usable as a session plan; you supply the delivery.

teaching_pattern.wednesday: Coding lecture — implement by hand, live (IC notebook)
teaching_pattern.friday: ~33 min lecture + 3 student research-paper presentations (8-10 min each)
teaching_pattern.presentations: 35 students / 12 usable Fridays (W2-W11, W13-W14) = 3 per Friday. W1 is course intro; W12 is Thanksgiving.
teaching_pattern.ic_format: Learning Goals -> timed blocks (Hook / build from scratch / move to library) -> instructor+student variants, student version carries more TODO blanks

depth_policy.rule: Teach intuition and 'what it's for'. Do NOT derive backprop, initialization variance, or optimizer convergence. Students should leave able to recognise, choose and apply — not to re-derive.
depth_policy.consequence: UDL ch.7 (102 slides) is now used ONLY for the conceptual BackProp section (~slides 31-57). Slides 58-99 (expectation algebra -> He initialization) are OUT OF SCOPE.
depth_policy.goal: Cover the full modern landscape: classical ML, NNs, CNNs, transformers/LLMs, generative models, RL — with diffusion/flow matching if time allows.

gaps_remaining.diffusion_flow_matching: UDL_13 names them but does not teach them. If you want real coverage, a dedicated deck must be sourced. Currently scoped as a high-level survey only.
gaps_remaining.final_presentations: ~17-18 pairs x 9 min = ~160 min = 3 sessions. Budget W14 Wed+Fri and W15 Mon.
